column3: The Hebrew names truth as the reason for displaying the banner; BSB describes fleeing the bow.
The Hebrew asks answer me in the singular; BSB asks respond and save us.
The Hebrew says in His holiness; BSB says from His sanctuary.
The Hebrew calls Ephraim the protection of His head; BSB says helmet.
The Hebrew commands Philistia to shout to Him; BSB makes Him shout over Philistia.
The Hebrew presents the second leading verb as completed; BSB says will lead.
The Hebrew does not explicitly say no longer; BSB supplies it.
The Hebrew says in God we will do strength; BSB says with God we will perform with valor.
